description: Claude Code only: wake this conversation when its attached Codescribe mailbox receives a message. Exit 75 from cs-bus is the only wake; every other outcome stays silent. After each tool call the probe surfaces an unannounced message inside the running turn and prints nothing otherwise.

hooks.command: PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH" "$HOME/.local/bin/cs-bus" --claude-code-wake; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 75 ]; then exit 2; fi; exit 0
